entities.summary: Newsha Tavakolian is an Iranian photojournalist and documentary photographer. She has worked for Time magazine, The New York Times, Le Figaro, and National Geographic. Her work focuses on women's issues and she has been a member of the Rawiya women's photography collective which she co-established in 2011. Tavakolian is a full member of Magnum Photos. Newsha Tavakolian was a painters & sculptors from Tehran (b. 1981, Tehran). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
